title: The coord hook posts an intent for any Bash text that holds 'backlog.py claim ID', a commit message or echo included
goal: The coord hook posts an intent only for a Bash command that runs backlog.py claim ID as a command, not for text that holds the words inside a commit message, an echo, a grep or a heredoc, so other sessions see no intent for an item nobody claims. Found by the SP-xo45jvbj review (G6, ST-x6mvfnmv): the CLAIM regex of coord_hook.py matches anywhere in the command text. Narrowed at the plan of 2026-10-17: a refused claim that still leaves an intent is the draft the plan filed beside it.

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite'))
E.pop('KB_COORD_URL',None)
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
def repo(n,b):
    r=os.path.join(D,n);s.run(['git','init','-q','-b',b,r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True);return r
def hook(cwd,**p):
    p.setdefault('cwd',cwd);return s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps(p),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=cwd,timeout=60).stdout
def c(*a):return s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=300)
r=repo('r','main')
hook(r,hook_event_name='PreToolUse',session_id='repro-'+os.urandom(4).hex(),tool_name='Bash',tool_input={'command':'git commit -m "mention backlog.py claim ST-zzzzzzzz in text"'})
o=c('digest','--key','ST-zzzzzzzz','--lines','5').stdout
print(repr(o));sys.exit(0 if 'ST-zzzzzzzz' not in o else 1)

import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
D=tempfile.mkdtemp();E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.sqlite'))
[E.pop(k,None) for k in ('KB_COORD_URL','CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT','CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA')]
H=os.path.abspath('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py');T=os.path.abspath('_tools/coord.py')
r=os.path.join(D,'r');s.run(['git','init','-q','-b','main',r],check=True);s.run(['git','-C',r,'-c','user.name=x','-c','user.email=x@x','commit','-q','--allow-empty','-m','i'],check=True)
def posted(cmd,item):
    sid='repro-'+os.urandom(4).hex()
    s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps({'hook_event_name':'PreToolUse','session_id':sid,'tool_name':'Bash','tool_input':{'command':cmd},'cwd':r}),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=r,timeout=60)
    o=s.run([sys.executable,T,'digest','--key',item,'--lines','5'],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60).stdout
    s.run([sys.executable,H],input=json.dumps({'hook_event_name':'SessionEnd','session_id':sid,'reason':'exit','cwd':r}),capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,cwd=r,timeout=60)
    return item in o
text=[('echo "run backlog.py claim ST-aaaaaaaa next"','ST-aaaaaaaa'),("grep -n 'backlog.py claim ST-bbbbbbbb' notes.txt",'ST-bbbbbbbb'),("cat <<'X'\nbacklog.py claim ST-cccccccc\nX",'ST-cccccccc')]
bad=[c for c,i in text if posted(c,i)];real=posted('python3 _tools/backlog.py claim ST-dddddddd --by x --commit','ST-dddddddd')
print('text that posted:',bad,'| a real claim posts:',real);sys.exit(0 if not bad and real else 1)

notes: Hygiene 2026-10-17: the old repro passed on origin/main 3dba0ef83 only because SessionEnd now releases the session's intents; the CLAIM regex still posts an intent for a commit message that holds backlog.py claim ID. The repro now reads the digest before the session ends, under a fresh session id (the hook keeps per-session state in the clone's _cache/coord_hook). Plan 2026-10-17: the repro fails on origin/main 3dba0ef83 (an intent for ST-zzzzzzzz from a commit message).
